judged_text: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, which overstates the page count by one whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit, so a 50-member group reports totalPages=2 and showingLast stays false on the real last page. An admin on any group whose member count is a multiple of the 50-item page size (including a plain 50-member group) can click Next into a page that renders zero members as '2/2'; the next-action clamp (line 33) then permits offset=user_count, fetching an empty list, and the phantom page is reachable from every such group with no data-loss recovery needed.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 pages). With `next`, the offset is clamped to `user_count` (`Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`), so for a 50-member group the admin can navigate to `offset=50`, and `Group.findMembers()` will request `offset=50` from `/groups/:name/members.json`, yielding an empty `members` list while UI shows `2/2`. This behavior is directly implied by the new pagination logic in the diff.
